session.description: Required after begin: exact returned session ID.

revision.description: Required after begin: latest returned sidecar revision hash.

target_text.description: For replace: nonempty text occurring exactly once in the staged document.

new_text.description: For replace: replacement text, which may be empty.

offset.description: For show: character offset into staged text; returns up to 4000 characters.

assets.notes: Standalone host-side tool; not enabled for coding cells. Begin requires the source hash, then each call requires the returned session and current revision. Staged work survives process restarts in an adjacent sidecar. Show can inspect a conflicted session; edits and commit refuse source changes. Commit validates Python or JSON and keeps the sidecar as evidence. Sessions and locks are not a sandbox; unrelated processes can modify host files, and clients must be trusted. The lock only coordinates cooperating Hornet writers.

assets.description: Search the public web and return bounded, untrusted result titles and URLs.
assets.notes: Standalone opt-in only: allow this URI explicitly and set HORNET_ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH=1. Sends queries to DuckDuckGo. Results are untrusted; this tool does not fetch result pages. Provider redirects and responses over 512 KiB are rejected.
